verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is fundamentally built around loading and running GGUF-format models, evidenced by CLI/server examples pulling GGUF repos (ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF), quantization support (1.5-8 bit), CPU+GPU hybrid inference, and multiple independent hands-on reports of successfully running GGUF models (7B, 30B, 70B) across hardware. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation snippet naming 'GGUF' as the file format itself (only inferred via repo naming) and no dedicated format-conversion/validation docs in this pack.
